audit.why: HARD 8/10 with early/mid Sylas dominance and TF map-play outs matches 49.84% over 6960 games and both kits.
Spikes correctly named: 3-5 (Q detonation + E dashes), 6 (Hijack + W sustain all-in), 1st item (Sylas kill threat), late (both scale, TF picks). All 4 spikes present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides said Sylas on all 7 rows while content win[] says Skill at rows 2, 3 and 6; breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: Rows 2-3 are genuinely neutral (max-range Wild Cards farm, Yellow Card held) and row 6 is two-item scaling parity per the content whys; Abscond/Abduct is 13s at rank 1, Kingslayer 12s, Hijack 80/55/30s.
audit.corrected: Sides 2, 3, 6 aligned to Skill with matching whys and ratings; real cooldowns added; bleed bullets rewritten to their titles.

audit.why: Missing-interaction anti-heal vs Kingslayer already covered by report[8] anti-heal line and 'heals faster than you poke' in mid.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: From max Wild Cards range you farm safely and stall to neutral — he only wins if you walk into chain range.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Yellow Card held and his 13s E respected, neither side cleanly kills the other — Q the wave, hold ground.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Two items in you both scale: your Wild Cards clear and Destiny picks even the game — pick and collapse, never duel him.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — dash into chain-pull; punish hard while it is down and check it before every step-up. - Kingslayer heal is 12s early. - Hijack recharges in 80s at rank 1 — your Destiny hands him a Gate too.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: A freeze at your tower shortens his 400-range E window to nothing — he must dive tower plus yellow card to touch you.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: With yellow card spent your only peel is gone — E Abduct into double Q and Kingslayer kills a plate-greeding TF every single time.

edits.before: Skill - you can hold safe max-range Wild Card farm, stalling the lane to neutral.
edits.after: Skill - you can hold safe max-range Wild Cards farm, stalling the lane to neutral.

notes: suspectNames: 'Chain Lash's' in early is a correct possessive (false positive); 'Wild Card' in whys[2] fixed to Riot's plural 'Wild Cards'. Chart fix moved full rows 2, 3, 6 from Sylas to Skill to agree with the content layer, whose whys are grounded; no win[] edits needed. Note Hijack on TF gives Sylas Destiny's Gate — kept in cooldowns rewrite as it is stated in Riot's R text (steals ultimate, casts freely). sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid remain TF-generic templates; nothing Sylas-specific in the kit justified a rewrite beyond what was edited, left in place rather than invent.
